text: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS beverage_revenue, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS beverage_items FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE LOWER(p.product_type) = 'beverage' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY beverage_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
